latest_validated_core_feature_head.message: Add fail-closed ISJ writer deadline consumption gate
latest_validated_core_feature_head.functional_increment: A separate fail-closed ISJ writer-deadline consumption contract now binds the independently validated writer projection to the exact promoted FactKernel deadline/evidence chain and creates a deterministic writer_consumption_evidence_id. A separately implemented independent validator reproduces that identity and proves four negative tamper cases fail closed. This increment grants only future shadow-writer consumption eligibility; it is not yet wired into the orchestrator, does not alter writer/article prose, and grants no article, site, social, production or acceptance authority.
